title: Scan to Comprehend
summary: Shape dense websites, articles, and infographics so readers can orient, find a fact, and understand its context.
author: TriunaLabs
origin: Original TriunaLabs workflow developed from a user-supplied Scan-to-Comprehend concept, revised against primary eye-tracking, visual-attention, and W3C guidance. No third-party code or datasets are included.
requirements: Python 3.10+ for optional structural preflight. URL preflight requires network access. Rendered and reader validation requires suitable tools and participants.
examples: Restructure this technical article so a reader can find the conclusion quickly and still inspect the methods.
Review this product page for readers comparing plans on a phone; show the top comprehension barriers.
Turn this high-density dataset into an infographic with a clear takeaway, readable comparisons, and a text equivalent.

preview.alt: Three linked reading stages: orient, locate, and understand, with headings and context.
